baseline_clean.description: Valid 8-packet hash chain with unbroken prev_hash links, sequential seq 0..7, and valid P-256 signatures.

chain_1_tampered.description: Tampered packet chain: packet at index 3 (seq=3) has co2_mass_short_tons scaled by 0.70 after signing, invalidating signature on seq=3 and breaking prev_hash on seq=4.

chain_2_seq_gap.description: Gap packet chain: packet seq=4 was selectively dropped, leaving 7 packets (seq 0,1,2,3,5,6,7). Triggers SEQ_GAP and CHAIN_BREAK at index 4 and exercises odd-node promotion in the 7-leaf Merkle tree.

chain_3_replayed.description: Replayed packet chain: packets at indices 4 and 5 are naive replays of historical packets seq=1 and seq=2. Signatures are valid for the old packets, but seq regresses (3->1) and prev_hash breaks at index 4 and index 6.
